_comment: Single source of truth for the generalizability-study ladder. Adding a rung is an edit here plus a rerun of scripts/extract_model.py; no analysis code changes. `family` is the nesting level: model is nested WITHIN family, not crossed with it, so cross-family and within-family comparisons carry different error denominators and the k-requirement differs between them. `system_role` records whether the chat template accepts a system turn -- Gemma does not, which is why the system-versus-user-only implementation level cannot be crossed with it, and why components are estimated by REML rather than by balanced-design moment estimators.

qwen3.5-2b.note: Qwen3.5 repos carry no -Instruct suffix; the plain id IS the post-trained release. Small tiers are Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration vision-language models, so text-only forward passes and hidden_states shapes must be verified before any number is trusted. Also mixes Gated-DeltaNet with softmax layers, so relative depth is not comparable to a pure-softmax stack.

qwen3.5-9b.note: bf16 exceeds 16GB; deferred to the 80GB-GPU run.

sad._comment: Raw item bodies from the SAD repository's own struct files, which are authoritative. The previously used split was recovered from released CSVs and had been round-tripped to CRLF, which changed BPE token boundaries and broke reproduction; see docs/preregistered-analysis-rules.md P2. Bodies are read from this local checkout and never copied into this repository.

pooling._comment: Every extraction stores both conventions so no analysis needs a re-run to switch. `validated` matches the reference implementation and is the pre-registered default.

_params_note: params_b is derived from safetensors byte totals, not from the model name; nominal names understate several models and the 7B entry was wrong by 0.037 in log10
